title: Upper bound for list encoding length
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, $f$ a function from $\alpha$ to Boolean lists, $B\in\mathbb{N}$, and $as$ a finite list such that every $a\in as$ satisfies $|f(a)|\le B$. Then the encoding of $as$ has length at most $|as|(B+1)+1$.
